title: Improve actor property inventory readability
changes: Separate byte units and counts in actor property and UI byte-input summaries while retaining the original validation boundaries.
validation: Compared the inventory with its immediate preimage: digit runs, headings, Markdown links and inline code match; text outside the selected summaries is unchanged.
limitations: Inventory review remains partial from the UI property-selected list section onward; historical runtime results were not reproduced and the wider English-first audit remains open.
